edges.reason: Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored into the stopTheBots state variable.
owner is assigned tx.origin, tying privileged access to the externally controlled origin address.
tx.origin is read inside the Howler constructor to derive owner and to grant unlimited allowances.
msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of transferFrom from transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance spender for allowance[_from][msg.sender] checks and updates.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing an arbitrary delegatecall.
distribute is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) but owner is tx.origin derived.
list is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner) but owner is tx.origin derived.
tx.origin-derived owner and allowances influence which transfers bypass allowance checks.
list reads block.timestamp to compute the Uniswap deadline, making execution time miner-dependent.
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the deadline of addLiquidityETH.
The checkBots modifier wraps transferFrom and executes an external call before the function body.
The checkBots modifier performs the low-level call to stopTheBots before any state modification.
The external stopTheBots call can re-enter transferFrom before balance and allowance updates occur.
The external stopTheBots call in distribute executes before balances are overwritten, allowing reentrancy.
The external router addLiquidityETH call can callback into the token while list() has not finished updating state.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall controlled by the owner/target parameters.
_value flows into the unchecked balance and allowance updates of transferFrom.
_from is the key for the unchecked subtraction on balanceOf in transferFrom.
_to is the key for the unchecked addition on balanceOf in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_from selects the balance entry that is decremented without SafeMath.
_to selects the balance entry that is incremented without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction writes to the balanceOf mapping.
Unchecked addition writes to the balanceOf mapping.
Unchecked subtraction writes to the allowance mapping.
_numList feeds the unchecked totalSupply * 6 / 100 computation in list.
Unchecked arithmetic derives a balance value that is written while totalSupply is used as the basis.
Attacker/owner supplied address a is the delegatecall target.
Attacker/owner supplied calldata b is forwarded to the delegatecall.
_toWho is encoded into the stopTheBots external call selector payload.
_toWho addresses receive overwritten balances in distribute.
amount is written into balanceOf entries in distribute.
_amounts supplies the values written into balances in list.
_toWho supplies the recipient addresses written in list.
_numList is passed as both amountTokenDesired and amountTokenMin to addLiquidityETH.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
BotProtected constructor writes the bot protection address into stopTheBots.
Howler constructor assigns owner from tx.origin.
Howler constructor computes and stores the Uniswap pair address.
pairFor returns the deterministic pair address stored in uniPair.
